title: Moses' Scripture was perfect for Israel then — always enough for the Church's need
source_text: XXIX. Itaque quanquam Scriptura, quum primum per Mosen data est, non omnia contineret quae nobis nunc necessaria sunt, sufficienter tamen continebat ea quae tunc populo Israelitico necessaria erant. Eamque perfectionem semper habuit Scriptura divina, ut omnia complecteretur, quae Ecclesiam facere & scire opus erat.
pass_a_gloss: Therefore although Scripture, when it was first given through Moses, did not contain all things which are now necessary for us, yet it sufficiently contained those things which were then necessary for the Israelite people. And divine Scripture always had that perfection, that it embraced all things which it was needful for the Church to do and to know.
pass_b_english: So although Scripture, when first given through Moses, did not contain everything now necessary for us, it still sufficiently held what the people of Israel then needed.
Divine Scripture always had that perfection: it took in all the Church needed to do and to know.

choices.why: Enough for that age, not incomplete forever.
